WINDSURFING ACTIVITY: Use this activity profile to track your GPS position, speed, distance and heart rate while windsurfing.

KITESURFING ACTIVITY: You can also track your GPS position, speed, distance and heart rate while kitesurfing.

Follow every adventure.

COMPATIBILITY WITH MULTIPLE GNSS SYSTEMS: Whether you hike, mountain bike, trail run or ski, you get access to multiple global navigation satellite systems (GPS, GLONASS and Galileo) for better tracking in the toughest environments than using GPS alone.

ABC SENSORS: Use ABC sensors on your next trip, including an altimeter for elevation data, a barometer to monitor weather changes, and a 3-axis electronic compass.

TRACBACK® ROUTES: Forget the complications on the way back. With this feature you can return to your starting point along the same route.

Live connected.

SMART NOTIFICATIONS: Receive emails, texts and alerts right on your watch when paired with your compatible smartphone.

CONNECT IQ™ STORE: Download custom watch faces, add data fields, and get apps and widgets in the Connect IQ Store app on your compatible smartphone.

CONTACTLESS PAYMENTS WITH GARMIN PAY™: Thanks to Garmin Pay contactless payment, available in partnership with participating providers, you can pay easily.

SAFETY AND TRACKING FEATURES: When your watch and phone are paired, you can manually send your live location to your contacts or have it sent automatically during certain outdoor activities with incident detection4.

CALENDAR VIEW: With a dedicated calendar screen, you can easily view your plans for each day when paired with your compatible smartphone.

PAIR WITH THE GARMIN CONNECT™ APP: View health and fitness information in one place. The Garmin Connect app on your compatible smartphone is a thriving virtual community where users can connect, compete and share.

Train your way.

DAILY WORKOUT SUGGESTIONS: Get recommendations tailored to your preferences and fitness based on your current load and training status.
